title: Rice with Noodles and Lentils
subtitle: a quick, filling one-pot meal
description: Soft rice and red lentils mixed with golden fried thin noodles for depth and flavour. A quick lunch or dinner that comes together in 30 minutes.

steps.text: Heat a medium-large pot and add plenty of olive oil. Fry the noodles with 1 tsp salt until golden.
Add 1 cup of water to the noodles and cook for a few more minutes until softened.
In a separate pot, bring about 8 cups of water to the boil with 1 tsp salt. Add the rice and lentils and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, until soft.
Drain the rice and lentils and add them to the pot with the cooked noodles.
Stir well so the noodles are spread through the rice. Drizzle with olive oil and serve.
